books.title: Getting Started
books.description: Welcome to your game. Edit these pages to make it yours.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.content:
This is the starter wiki for a game built on the platform shell. Its content lives in systems/<your-system>/content/wiki.json and is loaded into the database by scripts/seed-wiki.ts.

Replace this book with your own world's lore, rules and locations.

pages.title: How Content Works
pages.content: Add books, chapters and pages to content/wiki.json, then run NEXT_PUBLIC_ACTIVE_SYSTEM=<system> npx tsx scripts/seed-wiki.ts against a fresh database (idempotent - existing slugs are skipped). You can also author content directly in the in-app wiki admin.
